basic_info.description: Views of downtown, salesforce and the Bay Bridge from the upper level bedroom. This Crocker Amazon Home is a fixer ready for your creativity and imagination to make it uniquely yours.     This home offers 3 bedrooms, 1 bathroom within 2 levels. There is a spacious living room with closet, expansive formal dining room and kitchen with a cozy breakfast nook.     There is a flex space adjacent to the kitchen to create a walk-in pantry, utilize as a small home office, craft space or more.     Expansive fenced yard with a large storage shed and detached garage.
